name: real-skills
description: Everyday engineering skills built on compressed agent reports and a deterministic harness with Jev judgments: /real-skills:do-shit (tracker items to merged PRs via role-based subagent teams), /real-skills:changelog (release notes from promotion PRs or tags, linked to your tracker), /real-skills:quick-ask-me (short interview that ends in an implementation brief), /real-skills:ask-and-create-specs (Jev-gated interview that ends in a terse, line-capped spec), /real-skills:create-spec (sizes the work, asks at most one round, writes a terse spec other skills hand off to), /real-skills:create-plan (spec to an ordered task plan checked by a script: coverage, parallel safety, review gates, exact commands), /real-skills:wtf (read-only bug-report triage with a checked verdict), /real-skills:wtf-and-create-ticket (runs wtf, plans the fix, and files one ticket with the triage, cause, fix and plan, from a per-repo ticket config asked for once), /real-skills:improve-design (a design pass on one existing screen, built on the impeccable skill: each change compared blind against the screen before it, kept only if better, ending in a pull request), /real-skills:solve-merge-conflicts (makes a conflicted pull request mergeable again: both sides read, every resolution written and checked by a script, one push after a yes), /real-skills:fix-ci (makes a pull request's red checks green: every failed job read and classed, the fix proven by the failing command and checked for shortcuts, one push after a yes, CI watched for up to three rounds), /real-skills:clean-slop (removes the slop a branch added, under the repo's checks before and after, and asks before any cut past slop; one local commit, never pushed), /real-skills:review-prs (pull-request review whose findings are checked against the code and posted only on approval), /real-skills:qa-this (QA of tickets, PRs or a branch off production, with script-recorded results, evidence comments and a short report), /real-skills:check-infra-and-migrations (a script-computed verdict and runbook for the migrations and infrastructure changes a PR or promotion carries, with opt-in read-only looks at the target), /real-skills:promote (promotes one environment to the next through a gated pull request: script-computed gates, the infra check, two separate approvals, a merge pinned to the checked commit, then watch and verify), /real-skills:calibrate (checks the logged Jev questions against what was right and switches on the ones that earned it), /real-skills:handoff-with-prompt (writes a handoff file for the task in flight and prints a prompt that starts the next agent from it).
